findings.evidence_level: Middle supported; bounded higher-layer bundled-method explanation
findings.basis: A real default-SCIP versus FEASIBILITY-emphasis intervention with identical nominal profile, one solver thread/seed/tolerance, genuine event records and complete development outcomes. Five-class P155802.789097→76171.695603, three-class198645.509041→165342.444816, but single-class33808.970020→47173.278254 (+39.53%). Regression, fixed execution order and first baseline before design registration are explicitly disclosed. Mature solver configuration is a valid method; no originality requirement is imposed.
findings.limits_or_missing: FEASIBILITY changes a bundle of parameters, not one isolated heuristic. Single baseline integration preceded the six-run design; one run/seed/build and fixed order do not establish general causal superiority. The later new-input parser failure does not erase this valid development experiment.

findings.evidence_level: Middle supported; limited bundled-intervention economic attribution
findings.basis: Independent selected ledger/cost sums support five-class loading loss625→205 and port1 shortage402→36 with more sailing cost. Three-class total cost improves, but port2 shortage95→205 worsens, correctly stated. Single-class sails less yet incurs24 loading loss+124 discharge shortfall, overwhelming saved voyage cost. These are actual feasible schedules and deterministic objective contributions, not invented operating gains.
findings.limits_or_missing: The configuration intervention establishes an observed bundle outcome and its accounting mechanism. It does not isolate which internal heuristic or particular route caused the entire gain; no route-removal counterfactual was delivered. Alpha is modeled slack, not a demonstrated unavoidable real supply shortfall.

findings.evidence_level: Middle supported on development; general self-validator coverage contradicted by new input
findings.basis: The report honestly separates SCIP numerical full-model lower bounds, feasibility and unresolved optimum; no restricted/LP result is promoted to an exact integer optimum. The three original development models were independently valid. For the two new models the real optimizer vectors are also separately root-checked feasible and objective-consistent; its own validator falsely rejects them after parsing RHS incorrectly.
findings.limits_or_missing: The claimed complete assigned-MPS self-check is not reliable across the allowed serialized family. Native SCIP bound/optimizer correctness is separate from that defective parser. No candidate-owned exact rational certificate; external evaluator witnesses are not candidate scientific proof.
